the Seiberg-Witten approach to the strong CP problem is wrong.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Seiberg-Witten solution is not the unique solution of N=2 supersymmetric Yang-Mills theories.
supersymmetric Yang-Mills theories do not have an acceptable infrared limit.
we have found a dynamical symmetry breaking of the gauge symmetry and the supersymmetry in the infrared limit.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Seiberg-Witten solution is a special solution of a more general class of solutions.
the Seiberg-Witten solution is not the only solution to the problem of dynamical symmetry breaking in extended super-Yang-Mills theories.
the strong CP problem is solved by dynamical supersymmetry breaking in the IR and that the QCD vacuum is a unique ground state of the theory.
